prose: The New York Times examines the writings of Anthropic co-founder and CEO Dario Amodei - one of the tech industry's most prolific and polished explainers - to see what they reveal about the AI leader. Amodei has contributed to dozens of scholarly papers and, more recently, written a half-dozen informal essays for the general public.
